name: llm-router
description: An explainable, policy-driven router for choosing AI models by task, capabilities, cost, latency, privacy and reliability.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @llm-router/core --filter @llm-router/catalog --filter @llm-router/evals --filter @llm-router/observability --filter @llm-router/adapter-openai-compatible --filter @llm-router/adapter-openai --filter @llm-router/adapter-anthropic --filter @llm-router/adapter-google --filter @llm-router/adapter-openrouter --filter @llm-router/proxy --filter @llm-router/cli --filter @llm-router/testing run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/playground run build
scripts.release:check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm catalog:validate && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm pack:check
